scope: Material inputs only; does not alter or validate the repository simulator.

conventions.doping: Atomic percent on the Y sublattice, NOT percentage of all atoms.
conventions.spectra: nm and cm^2 per Yb ion in source CSV; helper also provides SI.
conventions.temperature: Kelvin in API; Celsius only in figure CSV column names.
conventions.strain: Symmetric infinitesimal mechanical elastic strain, after subtracting thermal eigenstrain.
conventions.source_quality: Published fits, source repository tables, figure readings and derived results are different evidence categories.

structure.number_density_model: 3*rho_host_300K/M_host * N_A * (Yb_at_percent/100). Fixed-volume substitution baseline; no concentration-specific lattice calibration.

default_spectra.doping_dependence: Not available; concentration only scales number density.

approximate_temperature_spectra.absorption: Derived from emission at the SAME temperature by McCumber reciprocity. Not independently digitized absorption.
warnings: Only main laser band. Pump absorption at high temperature is NOT included.
Manual readings are coarse and not original author arrays.
Linear interpolation does not add spectral resolution.

aggarwal2005.interpretation: Host stress-free thermo-optic baseline; not concentration-calibrated.

sato2025.interpretation: Apparent host dn/dT; authors report possible mounting-stress contamination. Not a safe automatic stress-free replacement. Text mistakenly mentions fourth/fifth order, but Eq.9/Table7 specify cubic/four coefficients; use Eq.9/Table7.

sato_host_k.uncertainty: Reported <1% fit residual is not total experimental uncertainty.

heat_capacity.quality: Published host summary including calculated heat capacity; interpolation of table, not direct calorimetry at every node.
